title: Work Item
description: A unit of work tracked throughout the software development life cycle, such as a user story, task, bug, or epic.

id.description: Unique identifier for the work item.

title.description: Short descriptive title of the work item.

description.description: Detailed description of the work to be done.

status.description: Current workflow state of the work item.

priority.description: Priority level indicating urgency and importance.

storyPoints.description: Effort estimate in story points using Fibonacci scale.

assignee.description: Username or identifier of the team member assigned to this work item.

reporter.description: Username or identifier of the person who created this work item.

sprint.description: Identifier of the sprint this work item is assigned to.

epic.description: Identifier of the parent epic if this is a story or task.

labels.description: Classification labels attached to this work item.

acceptanceCriteria.description: List of conditions that must be met for this work item to be considered done.

created.description: Timestamp when this work item was created.

updated.description: Timestamp when this work item was last updated.

dueDate.description: Target completion date for this work item.
